title: Leñol ngol luulndii njuɓɓudi tagoore
intro: E nder diiwaan mo daartol mum ina rewi e duuɓi, renndo ina wuuri e murto udditiingo e sariyaaji laaɓal. Golle maɓɓe ina keewi no feewi haa ɗe ciftortee ko jeertinaango wonande neɗɗaagal fof. Hol ɓeeɗoo yontaaji, hol ko woni baasal keɓtinaangal e maɓɓe ?
clues: Min ngoni ko e leydi ndi laawol ngol yahooɓe keewi rewde, kono min mbaɗti yahdu maɓɓe ko kulɓiniindi.
En mbaɗii golle bonɗe ɗe hay gooto e adunaaji ɗii meeɗaa waɗde.
Nelaaɗo gooto e men noddii en yoo en ngoppu laabi men, kono en njaɓaani mo, en ɗaɓɓirii mo jukkungo so tawii ko o gooŋɗinɗo.
Nde hoɓɓe belɓe ngari e wuro amen, min njiɗi ko ƴattaade ɓe, min nganndaa ko ɓe nelaaɓe halkaare.
En njeertinaama jukkungo hulɓiniingo so en ngoppaani, kono en njaɓaani jeertinaango ngoo, en keddii e bakkaat men.
Toɓo kaaƴe ummoraade e asamaan yani e amen, galleeji amen njippii, alaa ko heddii so wonaa maande wonande miijotooɓe.

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
